items.title: Wallace Davenport Interview, 1975-05-15
items.q: I think I recorded it for Paul Munch. Paul Munch. Yeah.

ctx.x: You sounded like you were from the Champ. I didn't know you were Irish. And it's for lies.

See, the thing is, you shape these guys up. Forget the microphones. But I mean, you know, you gave them a feeling of how the tune works and how it builds. To me. Yeah. And, uh, I think that... You know, all this music may change. It's always adding new things, but it always stays the same. And I've read an audible downbeat. I think I recorded it for Paul Munch. Paul Munch. Yeah. But that's the idea. You just add new things to the tradition. You keep the tradition. Yeah.
